## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Tests use only synthetic sensitive values.
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior changes.
- [ ] I reviewed any redaction rule for false-positive and false-negative risk.

## Safety notes

Do not paste real tokens, private keys, personal data, or unreviewed diagnostic reports here.
